info.name: TravelBestie Manager API
info.description:
Complete test collection for the TravelBestie Manager REST API.

## Setup
1. Copy `travelbestie-local.postman_environment.example.json` → `travelbestie-local.postman_environment.json` (gitignored) and fill in both test accounts (main ≥ 20 karma; the collab account is the co-editing invitee).
2. Postman app: import that environment too. If the backend has `RSA_PRIVATE_KEY`, set `rsaPublicKeyBase64` (SPKI, base64) to its public half (`node scripts/generate-keys.js`).

## Headless (Newman)
`npm run postman` runs every folder except 💸 Costly (manual), Cleanup last. `npm run postman -- --folder "🔐 Auth"` runs one folder.
The runner precomputes every RSA-encrypted body from `local.env`'s `RSA_PRIVATE_KEY` (Newman has no WebCrypto) and passes them as the `nmBodies` env value.

## Side effects
Trips created by a run are titled `[newman] …`; 🧹 Cleanup deletes them (also leftovers of a crashed run). Comments stay. One run costs the main account karma (AI + companion boost + trips + invite).

## Rate limits (normal, non-multiplied backend)
Per run: 2 collaborator invites (10/h), 4 register calls (10/15 min per IP), 2 request-otp (5/15 min), 3 main-account logins (10/15 min). So: **at most 2 runs per 15 minutes, 5 per hour**. A 429 in 🔐 Auth or 🤝 Collaborators means wait, not a bug.

item.name: Register - Email Already Registered
item.description: Requires testUserOtp to be set first. Run Request OTP, check email, set testUserOtp.

exec: // Newman: body precomputed by scripts/run-postman.cjs (its sandbox has no WebCrypto).
const payload = { name: 'Newman', email: pm.variables.get('testUserEmail'), password: 'testpass123', otp: '000000' };
const k = await crypto.subtle.importKey('spki', Uint8Array.from(atob(pub), c => c.charCodeAt(0)).buffer, {name:'RSA-OAEP',hash:'SHA-256'}, false, ['encrypt']);
const e = await crypto.subtle.encrypt({name:'RSA-OAEP'}, k, new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(payload)));
